question: On the saved probe table, is block (x, y) a ridge readout of z under the F2 episode split, at frame-level MAE below 20 px on both coordinates?
claim: Ridge(alpha=1) from z to (x, y) has held-out frame-level MAE below 20 px on both coordinates, and each MAE is strictly below the train-mean constant predictor.
falsifier: Kill if either held-out coordinate MAE is at least 40 px. Any other computed result that misses the support line weakens. Inconclusive only if the MAE cannot be computed.
assumptions: x and y are info['block_pose'][0] and [1] in the same units as the oracle 15 px gate
z is the stored float32 latent and has dimension 192; a float64 cast is not the F2 fit
the episode split is probe_theta.episode_split with seed 0 and test fraction 0.25, kinds rotation then random_only
MAE is the unweighted mean of absolute error over test frames, not over episodes
rotation episodes contribute four frames at nearly the same xy; the score stays frame-level anyway

baseline_pin.name: F2 ridge circular MAE on all test frames
baseline_pin.on_fail: abort before the xy fit and do not write xy_ridge_obs.json

degenerate_check: A train-mean constant predictor clears 20 px if a coordinate barely moves. Shared episodes, a train-frame score, a single-coordinate score, or a feature other than z also clears it without a latent readout. Support requires the F2 counts, disjoint episodes, z only, both test-frame MAEs below 20 px, and each of those MAEs strictly below the constant predictor.

next_action.continue: Reproduce the same xy ridge on one new split seed, on the Xeon. No new target and no second model class.
next_action.pivot: Restate one xy-readout claim and write its falsifier before any refit. Do not add a model class. Do not start B6 inside that revision.
next_action.kill: Archive B5. The next cycle may frame B6 only, on the Xeon, with a new frozen falsifier.
next_action.escalate: Stop. Do not rent a GPU.

literature_constraint: Maes et al. 2026 Table 1 block-location correlation 0.986 is not this split and not pixel MAE. It does not move the 20 px or 40 px lines. Source: research_os/cycles/001/REPORT.md and research_os/cycles/001/01_librarian.md. No new paper enters the ledger.
